_meta.purpose: The named causes of a Fill run's UNMAPPED rows (unmapped.json) and already-held rows (fill-report.json alreadyHeld). Rules are tried in order and the first pattern that matches the row's reason wins; a row no rule matches is a new gap kind and fails census.mjs --check. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions over the reason text.
_meta.owner_note: owner names the Spec 48 item (.claude/specs/48-CLONING-SYSTEM.md) that owns closing the class.

F-setting.meaning: no setting reaches a property the block paints

F-hardcode.meaning: a setting holds the draft value and a named framework rule still wins

F-block.meaning: no block or composition can hold the element

F-vocabulary.meaning: the token or preset vocabulary lacks the value kind (a slug, shadow role, fluid size)

F-behaviour.meaning: an SGS feature lacks the behaviour (a seen-but-unsupported row, FR-48-34)

W-walker.meaning: a measuring artefact (mispair, unmeasured side, consequence of another row)

W-route.meaning: a setting exists that the route did not find, calibrate or write

W-unchecked.meaning: a no-setting row that does not record every check as run, or comes from a run that records none: not a framework gap until they have

I-stale.meaning: the DB or a cache is older than the code

I-unrouted.meaning: a fitting setting has a NULL css_property

I-mistag.meaning: a setting carries the wrong role

I-calibration.meaning: dead, noMarker, untested or absent calibration

draft-defect.meaning: FR-48-34's closed list of defects in the draft itself
draft-defect.owner: Claude Design, or B5 for Eye Care

render-wins.meaning: the draft's code and render disagree and the rendered value is the target (FR-48-36); reported, never a gap
render-wins.owner: the surface report; Claude Design when the code is the error

CLIENT.meaning: a recorded deliberate difference or a client decision

held.meaning: a row already held and judged live: the equivalence engine found the value inert, covered, inherited or the block's default, or a reduced-motion record the motion model removes itself; not a gap

unassessed.meaning: a walker row that no Fill row and no triage verdict covers, so no class has judged it yet
